links.outcome: Radiologist-rated quality of plain-language simplification of radiology reports, including Hindi translation
links.effect: Highest score for detailing the report (94.17%), lowest for drawing conclusions for the patient (85%); case-wise scores similar (p=0.97). Hindi translation was not suitable for patient communication.
links.quote: The current free version of ChatGPT-3.5 was able to simplify radiological reports effectively, removing technical jargon while preserving essential diagnostic information.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline capability to simplify radiology reports and translate to Hindi using expert radiologist ratings, without comparing specific deployment practices or guardrails.
